artworks.title: Antilochus (Attic red-figure neck-amphora)
artworks.description: Louvre G 213: the Tithonos Painter names Antilochus on an Attic neck-amphora — Nestor's swift son isolated as a Trojan-War presence in early Classical vase painting.

artworks.title: Achilles Mourns Patroclus (Attic red-figure stamnos)
artworks.description: At Leiden, Antilochus stands left of grieving Achilles — the messenger who brought news of Patroclus' death — while Thetis brings new arms. Rijksmuseum van Oudheden.
